- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/sviluppo-siti-web/

Online stores with WooCommerce, Shopify, custom React + Stripe integrations. Multi-currency, multi-language, payment gateway integration.

Business automation tools, REST APIs, dashboards, internal systems. Built with Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker.

Complete ERP solutions: accounting, warehouse, CRM, HR, BI, manufacturing modules. Used by Italian elevator manufacturers.

### SEO, GEO and AEO
Optimization for Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini. Local SEO for Italy and Bulgaria. Schema.org structured data, technical SEO.

### Cloud Hosting
Managed VPS hosting on Hetzner with SSL, CDN, automated backups, 99.9% uptime SLA, monitoring.
- Starting price: €29/month
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/hosting/

## Notable Projects

- **Nexus Dominion** — Cyberpunk browser RPG with real-time multiplayer, faction warfare, and dynamic economy. Tech: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, Docker. 52+ database models, real-time PvP combat.
- **OU Nikola Vaptsarov** — Official school website in Bobov Dol. Tech: React, Vite, PHP, multilingual.
- **Panev Ascensori** — Italian elevator manufacturer e-commerce. 27 products, Stripe integration, CAD images, Schema.org.
- **CS Anti-Cheat v4.0** — FiveM/GTA V security platform. 40+ detection modules including DMA behavioral scoring.
- **Gaming Portal** — Multiplayer gaming platform with chess, belot, santase. Real-time matchmaking with Socket.IO and Redis. URL: gaming.carbonstealth.eu
- **Supreme Bot** — Bot management dashboard for automated workflows. URL: botpanel.carbonstealth.eu
- **Treti Mart** — Bulgarian marketplace. React, Node.js, Stripe, OTP verification.
- **ERP Ascensori** — Enterprise ERP for elevator manufacturer. Accounting, warehouse, CRM, HR, BI.
- **Compositi Store** — E-commerce + IoT for composite materials. Eurotherm controller integration.

## Tech Stack

**Frontend:** React, Next.js, Vue.js, Three.js, GSAP, Tailwind CSS
**Backend:** Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Prisma ORM
**Database:** PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL
**Infrastructure:** Hetzner VPS, Docker, Nginx, Ubuntu 24.04, Let's Encrypt
**IoT/Embedded:** Eurotherm EPC3004 (Modbus RTU/TCP), WAGO PFC200 PLC (CODESYS), Arduino, ESP32
**Payments:** Stripe, PayPal
**AI:** Anthropic Claude API integration
